title: Petroselinic Acid from Apiaceae Family Plants Ameliorates Autoimmune Disorders Through Suppressing Cytosolic-Nucleic-Acid-Mediated Type I Interferon Signaling.
authors: Guo, Yue; Wang, Yun-Ying; Wang, Yao; Liu, Yan-Hong; Liu, Jia-Yu; Shen, Yan-Yan; Cao, Ai-Ping; Wang, Rui-Bo; Xie, Bo-Yang; Pan, Xin; Li, Ai-Ling; Zhou, Tao; Wang, Na; Xia, Qing; Zhang, Wei-Na
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物抑制胞质核酸介导的I型干扰素信号通路，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: The recognition of cytosolic nucleic acids is a critical step in the host immune response against danger signals, such as molecular patterns from pathogens or tissue damage. Nonetheless, over-reactivity to self-nucleic acids leads to the sustained production of type I interferon (IFN), mediated either by cGAS or RLR, contributing to the pathogenesis of certain autoimmune diseases, such as Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome (AGS). Therefore, inhibiting excessive IFN production represents a potential therapeutic strategy for such autoimmune conditions. In this study, we discovered that petroselinic acid (PA), a natural compound isolated from Apiaceae family plants, effectively suppresses type I IFN production induced by cytosolic nucleic acids. Mechanistic investigations revealed that PA inhibits the phosphorylation of TBK1 and IRF3, which are key nodal proteins within the type I interferon pathway. Notably, molecular docking suggests potential binding between PA and cytosolic nucleic acid sensors, such as cGAS and RIG-I. Moreover, we found that PA effectively attenuates the expression of type I IFN and their downstream interferon-stimulated genes (ISGs) in models of AGS autoimmune disease characterized by excessive nucleic acid accumulation. Thus, our research identifies a natural compound that offers a promising strategy for treating autoimmune diseases resulting from aberrant self-nucleic acid recognition and the hyperactivation of type I interferon.
abstract_zh: 胞质核酸的识别是宿主针对危险信号（如病原体分子模式或组织损伤）免疫应答中的关键步骤。然而，对自身核酸的过度反应会导致I型干扰素（type I interferon, IFN）的持续产生，这一过程由cGAS或RLR介导，并参与某些自身免疫疾病（如Aicardi-Goutieres综合征 (AGS)）的发病机制。因此，抑制过度的IFN产生代表了此类自身免疫疾病的潜在治疗策略。在本研究中，我们发现岩芹酸（petroselinic acid, PA），一种从伞形科（Apiaceae）植物中分离的天然化合物，能有效抑制由胞质核酸诱导的I型干扰素产生。机制研究表明，PA抑制TBK1和IRF3的磷酸化，这两者是I型干扰素通路中的关键节点蛋白。值得注意的是，分子对接提示PA与胞质核酸传感器（如cGAS和RIG-I）之间存在潜在结合。此外，我们发现，在以核酸过度积累为特征的AGS自身免疫疾病模型中，PA有效减弱I型干扰素及其下游干扰素刺激基因（ISGs）的表达。因此，我们的研究鉴定了一种天然化合物，为治疗由异常自身核酸识别和I型干扰素过度激活导致的自身免疫疾病提供了一种有前景的策略。
